releaseNotes:
💬 WhatsApp-Style Persistent Conversations & Group Attribution Release (v1.2.2) by Dhiraj:
• 👤 1 Persistent Chat Box Per Person: Unified conversation key prevents split threads. Eliminates Instagram action noise ('sent a photo', 'shared a reel') and notification badge suffixes.
• 👥 1 Persistent Chat Box Per Group: All messages from WhatsApp, Telegram, and other group chats stay unified under a single group box, with each member's individual name preserved as sender.
• 📜 Complete Chronological Chat History: Ongoing incoming and outgoing messages append in exact order across app restarts and multiple sessions.
• 🛡️ Deduplication & Zero False Deletions: Notifications are deduplicated without losing context; dismissed notifications are never marked as deleted.
• 🎥 Photo, Video & Media Support: Full preservation of chat photos, videos, audio notes, and direct Instagram reel links.
• 🔒 100% Offline & Encrypted: Database automatically upgraded to v8 with zero data loss guarantee.
